mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM t_organization WHERE agreement_status = 'PENDING'

WITH station_daily_usage AS ( SELECT u.stat_date, u.station_code, SUM(u.usage_count) AS usage_count FROM t_station_usage_stat u WHERE u.stat_date BETWEEN #{from} AND #{to} GROUP BY u.stat_date, u.station_code ) SELECT d.stat_date, NVL(s.district_name, '미분류') AS region_name, SUM(d.usage_count) AS usage_count FROM station_daily_usage d JOIN t_station s ON s.station_code = d.station_code GROUP BY d.stat_date, NVL(s.district_name, '미분류') ORDER BY d.stat_date ASC, region_name ASC

SELECT u.stat_date, SUM(u.usage_count) AS usage_count FROM t_station_usage_stat u JOIN t_station s ON s.station_code = u.station_code WHERE u.stat_date BETWEEN #{from} AND #{to} AND s.district_name = #{district} GROUP BY u.stat_date ORDER BY u.stat_date ASC

WITH avg_usage AS ( SELECT AVG(total) AS avg_count FROM ( SELECT SUM(usage_count) AS total FROM t_station_usage_stat WHERE stat_date BETWEEN #{from} AND #{to} GROUP BY station_code ) ), priority_candidates AS ( SELECT s.station_name, SUM(u.usage_count) AS current_usage, a.avg_count, ROUND((SUM(u.usage_count) / NULLIF(a.avg_count, 0) - 1) * 100, 1) AS usage_growth_rate FROM t_station_usage_stat u JOIN t_station s ON s.station_code = u.station_code CROSS JOIN avg_usage a WHERE u.stat_date BETWEEN #{from} AND #{to} GROUP BY u.station_code, s.station_name, a.avg_count HAVING a.avg_count > 0 AND SUM(u.usage_count) >= a.avg_count * 1.3 ) SELECT rank, station_name, usage_growth_rate, review_status, total_count FROM ( SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY current_usage DESC, station_name ASC) AS rank, station_name, usage_growth_rate, CASE WHEN current_usage >= avg_count * 2 THEN 'REVIEW_REQUIRED' ELSE 'MONITOR' END AS review_status, COUNT(*) OVER () AS total_count FROM priority_candidates ) WHERE rank <= 5 ORDER BY rank ASC

SELECT organization_name, contact_name AS manager_name, CAST(submitted_at AS DATE) AS requested_date, agreement_status AS status, address AS area_name FROM t_organization WHERE agreement_status = 'PENDING' ORDER BY submitted_at DESC NULLS LAST, id DESC FETCH FIRST 5 ROWS ONLY
